messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: DB_CONN_EXHAUST in us-east-1. pgbouncer max_clients reached, redis MAXCLIENTS approaching limit. Auto-page to oncall group.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered: DB_CONN_EXHAUST · Incident #INC-20260315-42 · Urgency: high · Affected service: inference-db · See incident link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-20260315-42

jordan: ack'ing — I'm on it. pulling pgbouncer/pg stats and redis client counts now.

liz: thx jordan. quick sanity check: are we seeing a deploy or traffic spike? Grafana shows request QPS up ~2.2x in last 5m for /v1/generate in us-east.

jordan: no deploys flagged. looks like client-side retry storm from a few noisy customers. initial numbers: 95th latency api 2.6s -> 4.1s, error rate 5.4% (503/timeout). Affected region: us-east primary.

maria: if pgbouncer is saturated we can temporarily allow more clients or drain long-waiting sessions. prefer throttling at edge first. tag me if you want me to step in for edge rate-limits.

jordan: running checks:
```
# pgbouncer clients
psql -U pgbouncer -c "SHOW POOLS;"
# redis clients
redis-cli -h redis-main -p 6379 INFO clients | grep connected_clients
```
pgbouncer shows most pools at client_count ~ 2048/2048, avg wait_sec > 0.8. redis connected_clients 9800/10000.

alex: if redis hits maxclients we'll start seeing REJECTED clients. plan: 1) throttle noisy customers 2) enable pgbouncer emergency max_client bump + soft_restart 3) failover read-only traffic to read-replica pool 4) if needed, promote extra replica or scale redis.

jordan: doing immediate mitigations now: adding temporary edge rate-limit rule for top offender customer IDs, and running pgbouncer soft-restart (safe) for pool rebalancing. posting runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-conn-exhaust

liz: +1 on edge throttling. Can you paste the noisy client ids? I'll message growth/pm to inform them.

jordan: noisy clients: cust_42, cust_77, cust_99. Applying token-based throttle rule to 10rps per-token for 15m.

incident-bot: Action logged: edge-rate-limit applied by jordan. Rule id rl-20260315-1.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation timer set: if unresolved in 15m escalate to level2 (maria).

maria: acknowledged standby. if throttling doesn't drop pgbouncer wait we should consider emergency pgbouncer max_client bump (+20%) and point-in-time cache bypass for a subset of requests. That requires coordination with infra.

jordan: after throttle: connected_clients dropped to 1300, pgbouncer wait_sec avg < 0.05, api error rate down to 1.2%. latency back to ~1.1s. Rolling monitoring for next 10m.

alex: good recovery window. Action items:
- jordan: keep throttles for 30m and collect logs for postmortem
- liz: notify top customers and CS with rollback/bumped quota notes
- maria: prepare playbook for redis scaling if we see rebound

jordan: will hand off in 25m to alex for post-stabilization checks. tagging next oncall: @alex please be ready to take over at 1715501500.

pagerduty-bot: Incident updated: mitigation observed, severity reduced. If symptoms return, incident will auto-escalate.

alex: ack takeover. leaving current throttles for now. starting capture for pgbouncer/redis metrics and collect stack traces for open connections.

maria: noted — scheduling follow-up postmortem and CS impact summary. estimated customer impact window: ~10:12–10:45 UTC, ~5% of requests with 503s, most traffic from EU->us-east cross-region fallbacks.

jordan: handoff complete — documenting timeline in incident ticket INC-20260315-42 and adding runbook updates (add explicit edge token throttle step).

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-42 status: handoff -> stable. Last action: edge-rate-limit applied.

alex: closing thread here - monitoring will continue but no active page. :white_check_mark:
